description:
## Goal

Make the one retained InputFlowRelation preserve each direct-call argument frame atomically, including normalized local constants and exact origin-path operands. Relational semantic questions must pull back through a callsite by substituting one real frame, never by Cartesianizing independent input columns or reconstructing information the relation discarded.

## Proven defect

DirectCallFlow currently stores `inputs: Box<[BTreeSet<InputBinding>]>`. This projects each callee input independently and forgets which arguments arrived together.

Two source alternatives `[{a,b}, {c,d}]` and `[{a,d}, {c,b}]` therefore both retain the same columns `{a,c}` and `{b,d}`, although a callee question such as equality of its two inputs has different pullback meaning.

A smaller witness needs no branch merge: `same(x, :hit)` and `same(x, :miss)` retain identical relations. A constant or local-only callee input is an empty binding set, and Const/UnaryOp/BinaryOp definitions are not retained by input-flow extraction. Exact equality pullback should instead produce `LiteralEquals(:hit)` versus `LiteralEquals(:miss)` on x. No answer-key or ActivationKey change can recover a constant or correlation absent from the retained fact.

## Correct-by-construction model

- One DirectCallFlow owns a canonical set of complete call-input frames. Each frame is one real correlated alternative across all callee inputs; zero arguments is one empty frame.
- A frame slot retains the normalized semantic term needed for question substitution: exact InputFlowOrigin plus typed structural path/pullback, normalized literal denotation, or an explicitly conservative local term when exact inversion is unavailable. It does not retain display text, source spelling, spans, ValueId, ControlEntryId, Ty allocation order, or rendered types as identity.
- Structural projection and reconstruction continue to use the one InputPathStep and compose_paths algebra from InputFlowRelation. Dynamic map selectors, exclusions, remainder, list, tuple, and bitstring paths do not gain a second walker.
- Relational questions retain one normalized QuestionTemplate plus an operand tuple. Equality canonicalizes operand swap; ordering canonicalizes by swapping operands and reversing the operator; repeated-role aliasing is explicit. Literal substitution reduces the template to the exact unary question when possible.
- Frame extraction preserves control-flow correlation before value lineages are independently unioned. It must not enumerate impossible Cartesian products. Ambiguous unsupported local computation stays conservative and names only the exact source operands it may read.
- The existing World InputFlow fact remains the sole authority. Equal normalized frame sets retain allocation and generation and wake nobody. Source replacement withdraws obsolete frames exactly.

## TDD

1. RED: `same(x, :hit)` and `same(x, :miss)` currently retain equal relations. After the change, exact pullback yields distinct normalized LiteralEquals questions and no demand on the constant slot.
2. RED: coherent frames `[{a,b}, {c,d}]` and crossed frames `[{a,d}, {c,b}]` currently collapse to equal independent columns. Retained frame sets and equality pullbacks remain distinct, with no impossible `{a,d}` or `{c,b}` frame invented for the coherent source.
3. Equality operand swap, ordering reversal, repeated operands, and literal substitution have canonical typed identities independent of source/mint/order history.
4. Projected and reconstructed tuple, list, map, bitstring, delivered-result, protocol, and direct-forwarding operands stay correlated through their exact callsite. Dynamic and except map residuals use compose_paths.
5. Two calls to one callee never cross-connect frames or questions.
6. Branch, source, and job-order permutations reproduce byte-equal relation content. Equal publication retains the same value allocation/revision and schedules no reader.
7. Replacing a source alternative retracts only its obsolete frame and wakes only exact readers.

## Deletion and boundaries

Delete the independent-column `DirectCallFlow.inputs` representation and any helper or test that treats local constants as semantic absence. Leave no frame side table, compatibility columns, second fact, display classifier, or proof-only probe.

This ticket corrects the retained relation boundary landed by fz-kdt.214 and must land before fz-kdt.200 continues into relational QuestionDomain and ActivationKey identity. fz-kdt.200 owns the final finite joint question carrier, recursive solver, and activation cutover. fz-kdt.213 and fz-kdt.165 remain downstream.

Adjacent work stays separate: fz-kdt.188 removes a fabricated Cartesian ActivationInputRow during semantic target coalescing; it does not preserve InputFlowRelation call frames. Closed fz-kdt.81 concerned CallSiteTargets membership versus ActivationInputAlternatives and was closed without this production-path relation witness. Closed fz-1ah.8 preserves root Ty correlation during pattern reachability, not interprocedural question substitution.

## Acceptance

The retained relation distinguishes both falsifying witnesses, exact relational pullback consumes only real frames, and no downstream layer reconstructs discarded operands. The one relation remains immutable, deterministic, replacement-aware, and allocation-retaining on equal reproduction. Focused extraction/path/question tests, serial library, serial fixture matrix, all three target doors, cross-process determinism, documentation checks, cargo check, strict clippy, formatting, and diff checks pass. A fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review accepts the frozen diff before its one commit and close.
title: Preserve correlated semantic call frames in InputFlowRelation
